config_schema.title: Daily News & Content Discovery Service Config

fields.label: NewsNow Upstream Base URL
fields.description: Upstream NewsNow feed service base URL

fields.label: Freshness Window (Hours)
fields.description: Maximum age of news articles in hours to consider fresh

fields.label: Max Age (Days)
fields.description: Sliding window for tiered content discovery

fields.label: Require Latest Breaking News
fields.description: Prioritize latest breaking news with verified publication timestamps

fields.label: Default Feeds/Sources
fields.description: Comma-separated list of feed sources to query

fields.label: Enable Native Reddit Feed
fields.description: Enable native Reddit ingestion directly without external service

fields.label: Reddit Subreddits
fields.description: Comma-separated list of subreddits to monitor

fields.label: Reddit API Client ID
fields.description: Reddit API Script app client ID for authenticated access

fields.label: Reddit API Client Secret
fields.description: Reddit API Script app client secret for authenticated access

fields.label: Enable Redis Ingestion
fields.description: Enable ingesting articles directly from Redis Stream or List

fields.label: Redis Server URL
fields.description: Redis connection URL with host, port, and database index

fields.label: Redis Target Key
fields.description: Redis Stream key or List key to consume

fields.label: Redis Structure Type
fields.description: Redis data structure: stream (XREVRANGE) or list (LRANGE)

tools.name: discover_candidates
tools.description: Discover and score fresh tech and AI news candidates filtered by topic, date window, and quality thresholds.

limit.description: Maximum number of candidate articles to return

tools.name: get_candidate
tools.description: Retrieve full candidate details, research evidence fields, and publication metadata by candidate ID.

tools.name: enrich_candidate
tools.description: Enrich a candidate article with captured primary source snapshot, structured claims, and visual evidence.

override_url.description: Optional explicit primary source URL if different from discovery canonical URL

claims.description: List of grounded factual claims extracted from the article

visual_evidence.description: List of validated visual assets (charts, diagrams, code blocks)

tools.name: verify_research_readiness
tools.description: Score video production readiness (VIDEO_READY, NEEDS_RESEARCH, NEEDS_VERIFICATION, NEEDS_VISUAL_EVIDENCE) with strict evidence grounding.

candidate_id.description: Candidate ID to evaluate for video production readiness

tools.name: get_evidence_snapshot
tools.description: Fetch the immutable, SHA-256 content-addressed text snapshot of a captured primary or secondary source.

sha256.description: 64-character hex SHA-256 hash of the snapshot artifact

tools.name: get_discussion
tools.description: Retrieve community reactions, commentary trees, and sentiment for a news story (explicitly marked as community opinion, not factual support).

url_or_id.description: Discussion URL or post ID (e.g. Hacker News story ID or Reddit permalink)

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to retrieve
